_note: WHAT TO PUBLISH. Read by tools/build_packs.py (PLAN.md 3.2/3.3, phase 0.3).
THIS FILE HOLDS PUBLISHING DECISIONS ONLY. Title and description are NOT here -- they
are read out of each campaign's own campaign.json, because duplicating them would let
the store page and the game disagree about what a campaign is called. What lives here
is what campaign.json cannot know: the pack id, its version, and whether the game
requires it.
`version` IS BUMPED BY HAND AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. Publishing is the one step in this
project with no undo -- a client that has downloaded v2 will not look again until it
sees v3 -- so the number is a decision rather than a side effect of running a script.
build_packs.py compares what it built against the published packs.json and REFUSES to
write a manifest whose bytes changed under an unchanged version, which is the mistake
this guards: content edited, script re-run, and every existing install left stale with
no way to notice.
`required` is the owner's split (2026-09-03): true means the boot sequence fetches it
with nobody asked, false means it is offered in DOWNLOAD MORE and fetched only when a
player picks it. How To Play is the tutorial, so the front door would be lying without
it. Everything after the first campaign is expected to be optional.
A TEST PACK, and the only reason it exists is that the OPTIONAL download path had
nothing to exercise it: How To Play is required, so DOWNLOAD MORE was empty the
moment it was installed and the browse-and-pick half could not be tried on a phone.
The owner asked for one on 2026-09-03 -- 'does not need to be playable only
downloadable'. It is in fact playable, because deriving it from a real campaign was
less work than breaking one.
`derive` IS WHY THERE IS NO SECOND COPY IN GIT. It rewrites campaign.json's name and
description as the zip is built, so this costs one entry here instead of 2.2 MB of
duplicated content that would drift from the original -- and, more importantly, a
real scenarios/HowToPlayDummy/ folder would be picked up by the EDITOR's dev
override and show as a second campaign in every developer's campaign list forever.
`folder` MUST DIFFER FROM THE ORIGINAL'S. It is the install directory, the identity
Campaigns shadows by, and the key into user://campaign_progress.json -- so reusing
'HowToPlay' would not install a second campaign, it would overwrite the first and
inherit its progress.
DELETE THIS ENTRY once there is a real optional campaign to list.

derive.name: How To Play (Dummy)
derive.description: A test copy of How To Play, published as optional content so the download path can be exercised end to end on a device. Not new content.
